name: platforms-navbar-fit
goal: Keep nine navbar destinations reachable and search aligned to the right edge at every supported width.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Nine destinations remain reachable on first paint; global search stays at the upper-right above the compact revision row.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing search-fit matrix exposed the new nine-destination wrap boundary. Preserve its geometry assertions and add explicit destination and above-divider checks; retain screenshots through the normal fixture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint 5a321aff6ceed768ca30bfcbdb2399f69b02ef9ac68d0a905835fba1aa863047: unchanged search geometry fails at 834px and 768px; six original navbar captures retained.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 authored the shared responsive navbar repair: search stays with the brand, destinations take the next row, and compact revision controls remain below their divider.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint 5f5ed753fc36a02cc32d1816efca1e78d1ae6cb663c12b535127a7d59da95e6a: unchanged regression passes in the identical environment. Eight original captures retained and inspected; full navbar matrix passes 76 cases and Explorer matrix passes 113.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
